intervention_fixture: Two latent sources with identical sensor appearances, 2 allowed actions: source A outcomes [1,0], source B outcomes [0,1]. Learner sees only ordered (action,outcome) stream and terminal session boundaries, never the latent source ID, task label or query answer.
positive_training: 8 unlabelled sessions of 8 alternating controlled actions, with source identity selected by hidden fixture; train without class labels. Two novel sessions evaluated after one action-0 probe, then action-1 prediction; all outcomes deterministic.
negative_fixture: 8 sessions from two nominally distinct but response-identical source instances, action response [1,0] for both; learner must not split them or claim an identity before probe.
algorithm: online action-conditioned two-state Beta response posterior; create a new state only on a highly surprising action outcome after mature evidence; retain response profiles between sessions and clear only active-session pointer
comparators: single-state fully trained Beta response predictor
acceptance: After training, distinguish the differing action-response sources and predict action 1 accurately, while negative identical-response condition retains one state and unknown pre-probe identity. Any hallucinated negative-control split is a hard false positive. No claim of unseen transfer.
